notes.title: 1 Year Anniversary + Performance Update
notes.notes:
🎉 Aestik’s 1 Year Anniversary! 🎉
Today we celebrate one year of Aestik — thank you all SO much for joining us on this journey. 💜
It’s been an absolute blast, and we couldn’t have done it without your support!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43550964/1682c68f6172946e89868d7ee98ca252be7c63d7.png"]

To mark the occasion, we’re rolling out a special update:
✨ Improved game performance → the game should now run smoother than ever!

Thanks again for being part of our adventure - we appreciate you! 🥂


Also, feel free to check out our new upcoming game 💜

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3399930/Roulette_Dungeon/"][/dynamiclink]

notes.title: 🗺️ Aestik Patch 1.3
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43550964/3ae43f549d5b48fef393f932127cee52dc7c12f4.png

Hi folks!

Aestik's new patch just dropped - Addressing the most commonly requested features! 🤍


So, here are the Aestik 1.2 + 1.3 patch notes:


Additions:
 📍 Added player position on the map: The map now shows the accurate player position on the map! (1.3)
 📌 Added custom map markers: Click left/right in the area selection menu on your map to mark places of interest! (1.2)
 🗺️ Added new assist option: Item icons on the map show you the position of collectible you haven't found yet! (1.2)
 🎮 Back button works on all menus now! (1.3)
 ⚔️ Added more invincibility frames when getting hit by enemies (1.3)

Issues: 🐛 Minor bug fixes

notes.notes:

Exciting news! The time has come to...

We're super thrilled to announce that "Aestik" will be launching on August 26th, 2024, and we couldn't be happier to finally be able to share the news and hype with you all! 🤍

notes.title: DEMO UPDATE
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43550964/75a4330db3d4e3dd8f5c157b6c1e33297eb370dd.png


🍃 New Ability System + Quality of Life Additions & More! 🍃

Hi folks (:

We're thrilled to announce that we've just updated the demo once again!

We made a lot of "quality of life" additions & changes to improve your experience with Aestik.

As always, please feel free to join the official Aestik Discord to let us know what you think (...or to report any bugs you encountered). 🌱


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43550964/128ed686b9fc0451841bdce0d2a463c41be0b4ab.png


Here are the most important changes & additions:


 Rune System - Abilities in Aestik can now be equipped and un-equipped as you please + we've added rune descriptions! (see screenshot above)

 Map System - The map now highlights the room you're currently in!

 Improved Player Controls - You can now look up/down by holding the respective button while standing still!

 Visual Improvements - for example 🍂 tiny falling leaves 🍃 in the Bubblewoods that give the Realm of Aestik even more life and atmosphere! (:

 Balancing Adjustments

 Bug Fixes


Anyway, it's getting late - DON'T FORGET TO WISHLIST AESTIK AND SHARE IT WITH ALL YOUR FRIENDS, FAMILY MEMBERS, PETS AND PLANTS! 🤍⚔️

Much love,
Julia & Nic
